-- Phase 1: spec for config_value. Pure function, no capabilities.
-- Returns the value for `key` in `name=value` lines, or "" when absent.

config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  pre key.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex config_value("host=local\nport=8080", "port") == "8080"
  ex config_value("host=local", "missing") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    let name = parts.get(0) else ""
    if name == key
      return parts.get(1) else ""
  ""
